title: job
_what: ⛔ SNG-658 §2 — A PIECE OF WORK SOMEBODY POSTED, in `character.jobs`. Required is taken from `normalizeJob`, which refuses anything without them.
_derivedFrom: The live saves, 2026-09-26; each field's description says how often it is present.

^_._what: a note or a provenance stamp

label.description: what is to be done, as a task.

where.description: the place it is done at.

level.description: ⛔ how hard, as a person of that level — 1 to 100 (SNG-657 §1; it was clamped to 60, and a job's crystal, xp and harm all scale from this).

needs.description: what it takes: families with weights 1–3.

stakes.description: what it pays — crystal, xp, items, a deed, and the harm it risks.

detached.description: hands sent out on it who are not in the band until they return.
